name: edel-xStock mutable ERC-4626 share-rate oracle
summary: The wGOOGLx price source multiplied an independent stock price by wGOOGLx's same-transaction convertToAssets rate, so an underlying donation could atomically inflate collateral value and support reserve borrowing.

loss.notes: The seven lending reserve holders lose exactly 204,215.572188 USDC, 1.414889025557658614 wGOOGLx, 122.196850288612833306 wSPYx, 62.969726160938091585 wQQQx, 293.123092617121394703 wMSTRx, 99.854367795581762710 wNVDAx, and 37.589277017463227843 wTSLAx. Every archive balance falls from that exact amount to zero. The USDC reserve receives 180,000 flash-financed USDC and sends 384,215.572188, so the financing input and return cancel to the declared net depletion. Repeated wGOOGLx borrows and supplies, plus their eToken and debt-token representations, cancel inside the lending system; only the final 1.414889025557658614 wGOOGLx reserve outflow remains. It is redeemed and its underlying is donated to the wrapper, which capitalizes the borrower's retained collateral claim but does not return an asset to the lending reserves. The five other wrapped-stock reserves transfer directly to the attacker. Independently preceding DefiLlama observations value all six non-stables 686 seconds before the receipt. Exact decimal multiplication totals $406,564.79737383849000188598741420094817; the JSON number is its nearest IEEE-754 representation. The seed's approximately $204,216 figure counted only USDC proceeds.

ageReset.description: AaveOracle's AssetSourceUpdated event activated this direct price-source runtime for wGOOGLx. The mapping was zero in the preceding block and unchanged immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the constructor receipt and trace, every transfer touching the seven lending reserve holders, archive balances before and after block 25,434,062, the attacker's successful transactions through nonce 8, the custom source deployment and historical runtime, the AaveOracle source mapping and full AssetSourceUpdated log history, Etherscan's verified AaveOracle source, DeFiHackLabs' replay, and independently preceding DefiLlama prices. The nonce 0 constructor creates coordinator 0x1f05c70db2ffa1b1bac62b27e7678b765ebe7167 and two helpers. A 180,000-USDC Morpho input enters and leaves the lending receipt in full. Repeated wGOOGLx reserve borrows and supplies create offsetting transfers and internal eToken/debt claims; the final 1.414889025557658614 wGOOGLx leaves reserve 0x0ec96784aa6f47e456e0ce4eb2a8b00f1a6c9b74, is redeemed, and its GOOGLx underlying is donated to wGOOGLx. The seven reserve balances then fall exactly to zero. Subsequent nonce 1 through 8 transactions approve or dispose of the already-counted assets; their call traces do not touch any reserve, the pool, or either oracle. The generic AaveOracle 0xbd497ee429d9d3e46446339286271b3714a83b29 only routes getAssetPrice to the configured source, and wGOOGLx's donation-sensitive ERC-4626 accounting behaves as specified. The bespoke source 0x4c2c9df4559d80e0a7aa3c7f281704a7992f4ce2 is the causal artifact: its latestAnswer call obtains an independent stock price and calls wGOOGLx convertToAssets in the same transaction, making lending collateral value atomically borrower-controlled. It was top-level created in source-3 at block 25,396,205 index 206, timestamp 1,782,409,343; its 3,577-byte runtime is absent one block earlier and hashes to 0xa07fa1523344711cb047fc5867a5c05726227769eefcf5dc4690efcc7c295417 at deployment and pre-incident, with zero EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots. Source-4 emitted the sole AssetSourceUpdated event for wGOOGLx at block 25,403,763 index 89, log 169, timestamp 1,782,500,495, changing its source from zero to the custom runtime. It remained active pre-incident, so activation resets age and yields 364,992 seconds. All six DefiLlama non-stable observations are timestamped 1,782,864,801, 686 seconds before the loss.
